milestone_title: Deterministic rural building fabric streamed along settlement and road corridors
gameplay_value: Turn roads that lead to empty fields into explorable hamlets: deterministic 1-6 low-rise shelters per settlement anchor, each with a working door streamed ACTIVE-only at 192/144 budgets, giving the player readable village landmarks, shelter and future scavenge destinations, and road-vs-field route choices that complete the countryside settlement network and unlock future barns, farms and workshop inhabitation.
acceptance_criteria: --ruraltest finishes with finished with 0 failure(s): same-seed rural manifests identical shuffled incl. negative coords, different seed differs, 1-6 buildings per settlement by kind (village 4-6/hamlet 2-3/farmstead 1-2) spaced >=8 m and road setback >=4 m, no building inside floodplain/water/cliff or inside URBAN_INNER_M except gate barn, door faces road/settlement and obeys Door contract.

Geographic validity for canonical +4 alternate seeds: villages only where slope <14deg and distance_to_water > BANK_W+FLOODPLAIN_W+14 outside floodplain/forest, farmsteads only where slope < BUILDABLE_MAX and not cliff/water, rural buildings only where terrain_class != cliff and slope < BUILDABLE_MAX (<14 for village houses) and distance_to_water > BANK_W+2 and setback >=4 m from road, never on is_bridge deck — using real WorldConstants thresholds, macro-cell non-speckling proven by clustering.

Rural materialization budgets and seams proven: manifests byte-identical shuffled, building center ownership gives no duplication at + and - borders, each chunk <=1 rural shell collider (0 if none), verts <=320 (typical <=192) tris <=240 (typical <=144), doors <=6 per village chunk, 3x3 ACTIVE <=9 rural colliders, t_rural_gen/t_rural_mat in stats, at least 9 resident rural chunks around a hamlet+road+bridge transect.

ChunkManager streams rural with city+terrain+water+biome+road without duplication: 3x3 ACTIVE around hamlet near road+bridge claims active rural <=9, walking 480 m beyond UNLOAD_RADIUS unloads rural chunks and returning regenerates identical manifests (counts/footprints/yaws/colors/shell verts/tris/colliders/doors), debug stats contain t_rural_gen/t_rural_mat, generated rural excluded from save_state().

Determinism and buildability preserved after rural fabric: GENERATOR_VERSION stays 2 (additive), WorldPlan pure, CityPlan IDs and TerrainPlan 17x17 and hydrology CX/width 530-710/72/38-50 and biome contiguity >=192 m and road seam 0.02 and 9 resident road chunks unchanged — proved by --citytest + --terrainmaterialtest + --hydrotest + --biometest + --roadtest each finished with 0 failure(s) with retained seam/district_hint assertions.

Existing budgets not weakened: --citytest, --terrainmaterialtest, --hydrotest, --biometest, --roadtest, --cityruntime, --walkthrough, --havoctest, --smoke each finished with 0 failure(s) (3221225477 with marker is not failure; ObjectDB inside_tree guards added); closed leaf still blocks, walkthrough climbs 5 storeys no teleports, havoctest clear-shot honest, city 9/terrain 9/water <=9/biome <=9/road <=9/rural <=9 colliders intact (<=54 peak).
